the_ashen_crucible.title: The Ashen Crucible
the_ashen_crucible.subtitle: Single-Use Martial Armory
the_ashen_crucible.description: Run by Murn Ember-Spite (Duergar). Built inside a giant forge ash-catcher. Specializes in single-use martial gear and forge coatings.

the_single_stanza.title: The Single Stanza
the_single_stanza.subtitle: Arcane Consumables & Wards
the_single_stanza.description: Run by Nixie 'Ink-Fingers' Flit (Sprite). Built inside the hollowed spine of a giant tome. Specializes in single-use spell catalysts.

the_copper_alembic.title: The Copper Alembic
the_copper_alembic.subtitle: Apothecary & Diluted Elixirs
the_copper_alembic.description: Run by Gideon Vane (Halfling) & Brawn (Hill Giant). Suspended 40ft in the rafters in a giant copper still. Micro-diluted giant potions.

the_clockwork_alcove.title: The Clockwork Alcove
the_clockwork_alcove.subtitle: Salvage & Clockwork Gadgets
the_clockwork_alcove.description: Run by Keeva Copperpin (Rock Gnome). Located inside a giant wall-clock pendulum. Specializes in single-use mechanical tools.

the_sunken_hearth.title: The Sunken Hearth
the_sunken_hearth.subtitle: Tavern, Food & Lodging
the_sunken_hearth.description: Run by Barney Chubb (Halfling) & Lady Thrum (Cloud Giant Matriarch). Built into the Great Refectory fireplace.
